title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Quick fixes that compile, moves that keep their imports
summary: Two quick fixes left the build broken (a trailing lambda after "Remove unused parameter", a double comma after "Delete unread DTO field"); the sealed when branch insertion could not compile in a file importing its subtypes one by one; Move File forgot Java importers and same-package neighbours. Both are repaired, and two detectors stop calling runtime-resolved enums and request bodies dead.

highlights.title: Quick fixes that compile
highlights.description: "Remove unused parameter" left `showDialog("Hi") { … }` with one argument too many; "Delete unread DTO field" produced `val name: String,,` under ktlint's trailing comma. The trailing lambda goes with its parameter, and the last comma goes with the field.

highlights.title: Sealed when branches that resolve
highlights.description: The inserted `A ->` branch gets its `import com.demo.S.A` when the file imports subtypes one by one. A condition wrapped before its arrow no longer counts as missing, and a comment before the arrow no longer hides the branch.

highlights.title: Move File keeps the build green
highlights.description: Java `import …;` and `import static …Kt.…;` are rewritten, and same-package neighbours, wildcard importers and the moved file itself get the imports the move made necessary. Unsaved editors are edited as displayed.

sections.heading: Code actions
bullets: "Remove unused parameter" removes a trailing lambda with its parameter; a class body after `: Owner(a, b)` is never taken for one.
"Delete unread DTO field" handles the trailing comma of the last field.
Missing `when` branches bring their imports; wrapped or commented conditions are read.
Move File rewrites Java importers and adds imports to old-package neighbours and to the moved file.

sections.heading: Detectors
bullets: `enumValueOf<Mode>()`, `enumValues<Mode>()`, `Mode.class`, a DTO field typed with the enum and a Room `@TypeConverter` keep its entries alive.
A request body the app builds (`LoginRequest(mail, pwd)`) is not "deserialized but never read".
The Compose outline ignores comments and char literals and shows named slots (`topBar = { … }`).
